verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents in-product AI that works on the user's own financial data. Users can ask plain-English questions about their business. AI Close agents review transactions and surface discrepancies. An in-app "ask AI" button suggests transaction categorizations, and Accounting AI runs prompts on the general ledger. The MCP/Claude integration is external, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the depth and type of insights the plain-English Q&A produces, and independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Ask anything about your business, instantly, in plain English.
AI Close helps you automate and accelerate your month-end process using AI agents to reconcile accounts, review transactions, and surface discrepancies.
A user can click on a button and “ask AI” for help in categorizing a transaction —without context switching between tools.
Accounting AI runs prompts on top of your general ledger. The output reflects your existing accounts and categories.
